newsitem.title: UK: MGAM in bidding for Australian fund manager - paper.
newsitem.headline: MGAM in bidding for Australian fund manager - paper.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, the fund management arm of Germany's Deutsche Bank AG, is in the bidding for Australian fund manager Axiom, the British weekly newspaper The Observer said on Sunday.
Axiom manages funds worth A$18 billion (US$13.89 billion) for the New South Wales government, the paper said.
Four bidders are understood to have been shortlisted -- MGAM, National Australia Bank, Macquarie Bank, and Dutch group Mercantile Mutual, said the Observer.
National Australia is said to be the favoured bidder and has offered to move its fund management headquarters to Sydney if it gets the deal, said the paper.
Representatives of MGAM were not available for comment.

MGAM was fined a record two million pounds (US$3.3 million) by the UK's Investment Management Regulatory Organisation (IMRO) last week for a series of rule breaches and management failings connected with three of its funds.
